verdict.rationale: Seer, Sentry's own AI agent, scans incoming issues, finds root causes and automates triage. Seer Agent answers questions by pulling the relevant telemetry. Together these give responders AI-generated analysis of issues, but nothing documents an explicit incident summary or AI-enriched alert context. missing for 10: an explicit AI incident/issue summary feature, AI-generated context attached to alerts or notifications for responders, in-depth docs on summary output, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated summaries of incidents and alert context for responders

citations.quote: Autofix: Automatically scan issues as they come into Sentry, finding root causes, and automating triage.
Ask any question about your application and Seer Agent finds the right telemetry to answer it.
